car.name: Soapwort 1995
car.description: J.J. Lehto / Yannick Dalmas / Masanori Sekiya, 1995 Le Mans-winning McLaren F1 GTR #59, chassis 01R inspiration. Short-tail restricted BMW V12, six-speed manual, central driver. Original plum/ivory art; race setup estimates labeled.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: J.J. Lehto / Yannick Dalmas / Masanori Sekiya, 1995 Le Mans-winning McLaren F1 GTR #59, chassis01R. Original short-tail GT1 competition car, not road F1/LM,1996 revision or1997 longtail.

sources.access: ACO results: #59 chassis01R, all three drivers, overall winner on17–18June1995.
Manufacturer retrospective: racing power below600bhp, steel cage, quicker steering, suspension rubber removed and racing brakes.

Archived print of McLaren Automotive F1 GTR95 specification (original manufacturer URL/date printed). Not a current McLaren-hosted file or event setup sheet:441kW/600PS,6064cc V12,short-tail dimensions,1050kg,100L,18in wheels. Its torque entry is internally inconsistent with power; not adopted.

Contemporaneous November1994 first-hand engineering report/interview with McLaren commercial director: six-speed transverse synchronized straight-cut gearbox, selectable final drives, prospective air-restrictor rules. Pre-season report, not exact Le Mans settings.
ACO distinguishes1995 winner from1997 longtail and describes central driving position in parent F1 architecture.

estimates: Archived manufacturer441kW converts to591.39mechanical hp, not600bhp. These are1995 variant reference figures, not measured01R event output. McLaren explicitly describes regulation-limited power below600bhp. Intake restriction is represented through the effective curve; exact event restrictor diameter not verified or simulated.

Archived sheet527Nm/388lb-ft maximum conflicts with441kW at7500rpm, which requires more torque there. We do not copy that inconsistent torque claim:470lb-ft peak and all intermediate curve points are simulation estimates. S70/3 appears on archived sheet, but no claim of exact event engine serial or internal preparation.

1125kg simulated running mass is an estimate rather than1050kg reference weight or verified race load. Ratios/final drive, limiter,205mph/3.5s0–60 targets, suspension, aero/brake tune, mass distribution and equal305/35R18 tires are estimates. Geometry follows archived1995 dimensions;100L reference cell is not event fuel load. No road-car power, later sequential gearbox or longtail aero substituted.

Original plum/ivory/mint body and central cockpit, no copied Ueno Clinic/sponsor livery or logos. Native generic engine/sound, tire geometry and aero approximate the race car; no actual restrictor flow, carbon-brake temperature or V12 acoustics modeled. Central instrument and wheel anchors supported natively. Digital gauges, single left-positioned wiper and Auto Assist are gameplay conventions. Native tire opacity normalization affects decoded copy only; original PNGs preserved.
